About Oishi

One storyteller. Any industry.


The problem I solve

Brands tend to default to one of two extremes: dry corporate-speak, or generic content. Neither builds trust, whether the audience is a customer, a patient or an employee. The result is scattered storytelling, an inconsistent voice, and audiences that tune out.

How I solve it

My approach is one flexible framework, applied consistently: a content calendar, a format playbook across video, newsletter, social and influencer, and a habit of sourcing the real person behind every story, whether a customer, a doctor, an employee or a plant visit. The same process has powered a new center’s launch and a long-established brand’s internal newsletter.

Brands I’ve worked with

Healthcare launch: Nexus Pain Management Center.

Legacy and industrial: Tata Steel · Tata Tiscon · Vedanta ESL Steel · Tata Structura · Tata Nest-In · Tata Steel BlueScope · Tata Shaktee · Tiscobuild · TM International Logistics. Also Fuji Films.

It started with my own venture, Craft-à-Party, founded in 2020. I ran it actively for six months and paused it in 2025, which is where I learned to own brand, media and social strategy end to end.

Launch case study

NEXUS PAIN MANAGEMENT CENTER

A hospital-center launch, led by stories.

Problem

A new pain-management center in Kolkata needed enquiries and walk-ins from launch day, in a category where patients look for trust before they look for offers.

Solution

I led the marketing end to end, from pre-launch through the 3 September launch. Influencer storytelling videos promoted the center indirectly. Doctor-led conceptual videos built the YouTube channel. Meta ads, Instagram content, SEO blogs and website copy supported both. Influencer campaigns were run start to finish: creator research, outreach, negotiation, briefs.

Enquiries and hospital walk-ins within 20 days of launch, through organic influencer marketing alone.
